marketAnalysis.locationContext: Channi Himmat is Jammu's preeminent upscale residential and commercial sector, inhabited by Jammu's political, judicial, business, and medical elite. Located adjacent to the Bye-Pass (NH-44) and the Bahu Plaza commercial district, it experiences massive local footfall and premium destination traffic.

culinaryPillars.description: Slow-simmered in traditional deghs using hand-beaten mutton, Kishtwar saffron (kesar), dried cockscomb flower (mawal) for natural deep crimson luster, and Himalayan shallot paste (praan).
Clay ovens fired by artisanal coal, smoking marinated meats, delicate malai broccoli, and melt-in-mouth Awadhi Galouti kebabs with saffron-scented breads.
High-flame wok toss delivering authentic smoky 'wok hei', crackling chili lotus stem, and zesty dragon chicken.
Dramatic tabletop sizzling platters with herb-butter rice, caramelized onions, seasonal greens, and homemade demiglace sauces.
Simmered Kashmiri Kahwa with crushed green cardamoms and slivered almonds, alongside chilled saffron kulfis and hot walnut brownies.

visualIdentity.aestheticPhilosophy: Evoking the warm luminescence of Himalayan copper samovars and clay tandoor embers against velvet obsidian shadows. Avoids cold clinical minimalism in favor of rich, aristocratic Indian hospitality.

hero.headline: Where Aromatic Heritage Meets Modern Gastronomy
hero.subheadline: Experience Jammu's grandest table — from the slow-simmered brass deghs of Kashmir to royal clay-oven tandoor feasts and theatrical international sizzlers.

ourStory.title: A Legacy of Warmth in the City of Temples
ourStory.lead: At Aroma, we believe dining is not merely sustenance — it is a communion of fire, heirloom botanicals, and Jammu's legendary Mehmaan-Nawaazi.
narrative: Situated in the prestigious heart of Channi Himmat, Aroma was conceived to bring the true aristocratic culinary heritage of Jammu and Kashmir to life. Our culinary journey pays homage to the time-honored slow-cooking methods of royal Mughal kitchens and authentic Kashmiri Wazwan guilds.

We never compromise on provenance: our saffron travels straight from the terraced meadows of Kishtwar, our dried cockscomb (mawal) is harvested by hand in the Kashmir Valley to yield that majestic ruby glow in our Rogan Josh, and our tandoors are fueled exclusively by natural charcoal for that unmistakable rustic fragrance.

Whether hosting grand celebratory family gatherings in our plush banquet suites or indulging in quiet candlelight dinner moments, every guest at Aroma is greeted with the venerable warmth that Jammu has cherished for centuries.
ourStory.quote: A dish without genuine aroma is a story half-told. We slow-cook every degh until the spices whisper perfection.

categories.name: The Royal Tandoor & Starters
categories.shortDesc: Clay-oven embers, hand-pounded saffron marinades & melt-in-mouth kebabs

items.name: Galouti Kebab with Ulte Tawe Ka Paratha
items.description: Finely minced prime mutton infused with 32 fragrant potli spices and raw papaya, smoked on charcoal and served on a saffron-brushed baby paratha that melts on the tongue.

items.name: Peshawari Murgh Tikka
items.description: Tender boneless chicken morsels steeped overnight in hung curd, charred garlic, yellow chili powder, and Kishtwar saffron, fire-roasted to succulent char in our clay degh.

items.name: Bhatti Da Mutton Seekh Kebab
items.description: Hand-ground young lamb blended with fresh mint, coriander root, crushed coriander seeds, and brown onion paste, skewered over glowing tamarind-wood coals.

items.name: Amritsari Crispy Ajwaini Fish
items.description: Delicate river sole fillets marinated in roasted carom seeds (ajwain), crushed ginger-garlic, Kashmiri degi mirch, and light gram flour batter, fried to an irresistible golden crisp.

items.name: Dahi Ke Shammi Kebab
items.description: Silken patties of hung curd folded with finely chopped green chilies, toasted pistachios, and fresh mint, griddled with pure desi ghee for a crisp shell and creamy center.

items.name: Tandoori Malai Broccoli
items.description: Fresh mountain broccoli florets steeped in Philadelphia cream cheese, crushed green cardamom, roasted mace, and cheddar cream, lightly blistered in the tandoor.

items.name: Paneer Angara Tikka
items.description: Blocks of artisanal cottage cheese marinated in mustard oil infused with smoked red chili paste, roasted cumin, and dried fenugreek leaves, charred with bell peppers.

items.name: Bharwan Tandoori Khumb (Stuffed Mushrooms)
items.description: Plump button mushrooms stuffed with spiced cottage cheese, minced stems, and bell peppers, coated in an ajwain-curd marinade and clay-oven roasted.

items.name: Aroma Grand Royal Kebab Platter
items.description: The emperor's feast: 2 Peshawari Murgh Tikka, 2 Bhatti Mutton Seekh, 2 Galouti Kebabs, and 2 Amritsari Fish Fries, served on a smoking sizzler plate with mint chutney and pickled onions.

categories.name: Kashmiri Wazwan & Heritage Curries
categories.shortDesc: Heirloom slow-simmered brass degh curries, Kishtwar saffron & Pandit recipes

items.name: Kashmiri Mutton Rogan Josh
items.description: The jewel of Kashmiri dining. Prime cuts of tender bone-in mutton slow-simmered in mustard oil, bruised Kashmiri fennel (saunf), dry ginger (sonth), and the ruby-red extract of mountain cockscomb flowers (mawal).

items.name: Mutton Rista
items.description: Hand-beaten mutton meatballs prepared by traditional Kashmiri ustads on a stone mortar, simmered in a shimmering, fiery saffron-infused red cardamom gravy.

items.name: Kashmiri Gushtaba
items.description: Known as the dish of kings. Silky hand-pounded mutton sphere poached in an aromatic, velvety yogurt and mutton stock emulsion perfumed with green cardamom and dry mint.

items.name: Murgh Lababdar
items.description: Clay-oven charred tandoori chicken tikka simmered in a luscious tomato, cashew nut, and caramelized onion gravy finished with hand-crumbled cottage cheese and kasuri methi.

items.name: Murgh Methi Malai
items.description: Succulent chicken morsels cooked gently in a white cashew-poppy seed gravy fragrant with fresh mountain fenugreek leaves and green cardamom cream.

items.name: Authentic Kashmiri Dum Aloo
items.description: Baby potatoes pricked and deep-fried in cold-pressed mustard oil, then slow-dum cooked in a thick gravy of beaten curd, crushed Kashmiri red chilies, asafoetida (hing), and dry ginger.

items.name: Nadru Yakhni (Lotus Stem Gravy)
items.description: Tender Jammu & Kashmir lotus stem rounds simmered delicately in a velvety spiced yogurt gravy tempered with dried mint, crushed cloves, and fennel powder.

items.name: Paneer Butter Masala 'Aroma Special'
items.description: Soft malai paneer cubes simmered in our signature velvet makhani gravy enriched with fresh churned butter, honey, and roasted kasuri methi.

items.name: Dal Makhani 'Slow-Cooked Bukhara Style'
items.description: Whole black urad lentils and kidney beans simmered overnight on dying tandoor coals for 16 hours with plum tomatoes, white butter, and aromatic cream.

items.name: Pindi Chana with Dogra Anardana
items.description: Authentic chickpeas slow-simmered with black tea leaves and wild Jammu pomegranate seed (anardana) powder, topped with ginger juliennes and slitted green chilies.

categories.name: Indo-Chinese Wok & Street Aromas
categories.shortDesc: High-flame wok tossed favorites, fiery Szechuan crunch & golden dumplings

items.name: Crispy Honey Chili Lotus Stem
items.description: Thinly sliced Kashmiri lotus stem wok-glazed in amber wild honey, toasted sesame seeds, fresh red chilies, and scallions. Irresistibly crisp.

items.name: Chili Paneer Dry Tossed with Scallions
items.description: Cubes of batter-crisped cottage cheese wok-tossed with tri-color bell peppers, roasted garlic, cracked black pepper, and dark soy glaze.

items.name: Kung Pao Chicken with Roasted Peanuts
items.description: Juicy diced chicken stir-fried with scorched dried whole red chilies, crunchy roasted peanuts, and spring onions in a sweet-savory ginger-soy glaze.

items.name: Drums of Heaven (Szechuan Chili Glaze)
items.description: Crisp chicken lollipops tossed in a fiery house-fermented garlic-Szechuan pepper reduction with scallions.

items.name: Smoked Burnt Garlic Hakka Noodles
items.description: Thin wheat noodles flash-tossed in high flame with golden burnt garlic, julienned seasonal vegetables, and light soy sauce.

items.name: Golden Corn & Water Chestnut Dimsums
items.description: Translucent steamed dumplings stuffed with crunchy water chestnuts, sweet corn, and bird's eye chili, served with fiery chili dip.

categories.name: Artisanal Sizzlers & Continental
categories.shortDesc: Theatrical cast-iron sizzling platters, herb demiglace & handcrafted pastas

items.name: Aroma Signature Cottage Cheese Sizzler
items.description: Grilled marinated cottage cheese steak perched on a bed of butter-tossed herb rice, accompanied by charred seasonal vegetables, crispy french fries, and piping hot pepper-mushroom demiglace.

items.name: Char-Grilled Herb Chicken Sizzler
items.description: Succulent grilled chicken breast infused with rosemary and thyme butter, served on smoking cast iron with buttered pilaf, grilled tomato, and roasted garlic brown jus.

items.name: Aroma Tandoori Mixed Grill Sizzler
items.description: The best of both worlds: sizzler plate loaded with chicken tikka, mutton seekh kebab, and grilled river fish, flambéed tableside with aromatic butter.

items.name: Penne Alfredo with Truffle Essence & Mushrooms
items.description: Durum wheat penne tossed in a velvety cream sauce made from aged parmesan, sautéed wild mushrooms, and a delicate touch of white truffle oil. Served with toasted herb baguette.

categories.name: Dum Biryanis & Tandoori Breads
categories.shortDesc: Aromatic sealed handi biryanis with rose water & saffron-glazed artisanal breads

items.name: Kashmiri Gosht Dum Biryani
items.description: Aged long-grain basmati rice layered with succulent baby lamb marinated in Kishtwar saffron, mace, kewra water, and caramelized onions, sealed with dough in a clay handi and slow-steamed.

items.name: Royal Murgh Awadhi Biryani
items.description: Fragrant basmati cooked with tender chicken pieces, saffron milk, green cardamom, and fresh mint, accompanied by tempered pomegranate curd.

items.name: Kashmiri Shahi Meetha Pulao
items.description: Fragrant basmati rice gently sweetened and enriched with golden raisins, whole almonds, walnuts, fried coconut shavings, and pure saffron strings.

items.name: Subz Handi Dum Biryani
items.description: Seasonal garden vegetables, baby potatoes, and paneer cubes marinated in yogurt and whole spices, layered with saffron rice and slow-cooked in a sealed clay pot.

items.name: Amritsari Chur Chur Naan with Spiced Butter
items.description: Flaky layered tandoori bread stuffed with spiced paneer and potato mash, crushed by hand and drenched with country butter.

items.name: Traditional Kashmiri Sheermal
items.description: Saffron-flavored traditional flatbread prepared with milk, pure ghee, and a gentle hint of cardamom, baked in a low-fire clay tandoor.

items.name: Roasted Garlic Butter Naan
items.description: Leavened refined flour bread studded with finely chopped roasted garlic and fresh coriander, brushed with salted butter.

items.name: Pudina Laccha Paratha
items.description: Multi-layered whole wheat bread dusted with dried mountain mint flakes and griddled with desi ghee in the tandoor.

categories.name: Desserts, Artisanal Mocktails & Kahwa
categories.shortDesc: Simmered Kashmiri Kahwa, royal kesar phirni & smoky signature elixirs

items.name: Shahi Kesari Phirni in Clay Kasora
items.description: Silken ground rice pudding slow-simmered with reduced full-cream milk, crushed green cardamom, and Kishtwar saffron, set in traditional unglazed clay kasoras and crowned with edible silver vark and pistachio slivers.

items.name: Royal Matka Kulfi with Falooda
items.description: Dense, caramelized artisanal milk kulfi infused with saffron and roasted almonds, served alongside rose syrup, basil seeds, and chilled vermicelli falooda.

items.name: Sizzling Walnut Brownie with Belgian Gelato
items.description: Warm, fudge-rich dark chocolate walnut brownie served on a hissing cast iron platter, topped with handcrafted Madagascar vanilla gelato and drenched tableside in molten Belgian dark chocolate.

items.name: Authentic Kashmiri Kehwa with Saffron & Almonds
items.description: Simmered in an ornate brass samovar: delicate green tea leaves brewed with crushed green cardamom, cinnamon bark, pure Kishtwar saffron strings, and crunchy almond slivers.

items.name: Aroma Smoked Saffron Spiced Sour
items.description: Signature mocktail: freshly pressed Valencia orange, saffron honey reduction, fresh lime, and ginger bitters, captured under an applewood smoke dome and unveiled tableside.

items.name: Jamun Kala Khatta Fizzy Mist
items.description: Wild jamun pulp shaken with black rock salt, roasted cumin syrup, fresh mint, and sparkling tonic, rimmed with Kashmiri chili dust.

items.name: Channi Himmat Sunset Cooler
items.description: Layered passionfruit puree, ruby pomegranate juice, muddled mint sprigs, and lime soda over crushed ice.

tier1Analysis.pros: Zero build dependencies, single-file or lightweight static deployment, instant browser rendering.
tier1Analysis.cons: Managing multi-dimensional state (filtering by 6 categories, pure-veg vs non-veg toggles, chef's special filters, search queries, dynamic price sorting, interactive reservation modals, and floating order trays) quickly leads to brittle DOM manipulation, messy event listeners, and code bloat. Maintenance for restaurant staff becomes cumbersome.

tier2Analysis.tier: Tier 2: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
tier2Analysis.pros: 1. Lightning-fast client-side reactive state: Instant zero-latency dish filtering by category, dietary preference (Veg / Non-Veg / Chef's Special), and live text search across 40+ dishes. 2. Componentized Architecture: Isolates the Menu Card, Dietary Badge, Reservation Modal, Story Carousel, and Mobile Floating Action Bar into clean, maintainable units. 3. Polished Micro-Interactions: Effortless animations for the smoke-glow aesthetic, sticky category header scroll-spy, and table reservation validation. 4. Superior Mobile Performance: Vite compiles down to an ultra-optimized static bundle with sub-second First Contentful Paint (<0.8s) and 98+ Lighthouse mobile performance scores.
tier2Analysis.cons: Requires a brief build step (Vite build) during deployment, which is trivial with modern tooling.

techStackRecommendation.verdict: Adopt Tier 2 (React + Vite + Tailwind CSS). The user experience required for a luxury multi-cuisine restaurant in an upscale market like Channi Himmat demands seamless interactive filtering, zero-lag menu search, modal dish inspections, and a fluid reservation booking flow that elevates brand prestige above a static PDF-style menu.
